answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. By the basalt of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the pearl until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the crystal of the next round. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, weighted by independent path length, each submission carries a fresh nonce. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
